summary: Missing authentication mechanism on login endpoint

validation.note: ground truth does not mark this path as requiring authentication

remediation.config_change: Require an authenticated session (and the appropriate role) on GET /auth/login; register the check in shared middleware so new routes inherit it; return 401 without credentials and 403 for the wrong role.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx ^/auth/login" "id:9100005,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay auth-missing virtual patch f-edf5f326ea0f5b36',tag:'assay/auth-missing'"
{"class":"auth-missing","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-edf5f326ea0f5b36","id":9100005,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_URI \"@rx ^/auth/login\" \"id:9100005,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay auth-missing virtual patch f-edf5f326ea0f5b36',tag:'assay/auth-missing'\""}

summary: Login form contains a reflected XSS vulnerability via the username field

remediation.config_change: HTML-escape <parameter> before writing it into the page for GET /login.php (html/template or the framework's auto-escaping renderer); send Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 and a Content-Security-Policy without 'unsafe-inline'.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:* "@detectXSS" "id:9100002,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,msg:'assay xss-reflected virtual patch f-ca9f2b2faefaac4c',tag:'assay/xss-reflected'"
